info.title: JiaClaw HTTP API
info.description:
JiaClaw HTTP API. Session/chat authentication follows the API Token configuration; jobs and channels administration always requires an API Token and SQLite. Deployment and migration: docs/configuration.md and docs/deployment.md.

Telegram/Slack/Discord/Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk hooks are disabled until platform authentication and explicit installation, sender, conversation and tool policies are configured. Valid events receive ACK after durable admission. Supervised workers atomically persist the complete outbound plan with session results, without truncating replies. Unknown sends require operator review and never replay automatically. Discord interaction replies use encrypted short-lived interaction tokens without Bot Authorization; separately authorized scheduled Bot sends use server-held Bot credentials and verify application/guild/channel identity.

Scheduled notifications support explicitly authorized Telegram/Slack/Discord/Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk destinations, using a separate scheduled_destinations allowlist and installation tool policy. Computation completion does not imply platform delivery. See docs/channels.md and docs/scheduled-delivery.md.

Body limits, rate limits, CORS, metrics and session TTL follow instance configuration. Chat SSE currently sends chunks after the full tool loop; token streaming is not implemented.

Configured rate limits include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (Unix seconds); HTTP 429 includes Retry-After (seconds). http.max_body_bytes defaults to 1048576 bytes and oversized requests return HTTP 413. Responses carry X-Request-Id.

Opt-in http.tracked_turns adds UUIDv4 create-only requests, bounded async owners, atomic session/result receipts and explicit cancellation/review. Strict single Bearer required; tenant gateway excludes these routes. See docs/http-turns.md.

put.description: Create-only, never replacement. Available only in standalone scheduler mode with create_identity_protocol=job-id-v1; rejected by both the tenant gateway and gateway-driven backends. New identities require a running scheduler and current tool/destination authorization. The same identity and typed JobSpec fingerprint return the existing current job, including paused or deleted state, without enabling it or changing its next due time, even if scheduler health or tool policy changed. Object key order and omitted default fields are normalized; tool array order and all string values remain exact. A different specification, a legacy job without a matching receipt, or a purged identity returns 409. Receipt tombstones survive purge, store only ID and SHA-256, and are never automatically removed; 10000 lifetime identities per database, then new identities fail closed. No automatic HTTP retry; GET the known job ID or explicitly repeat the exact PUT after reviewing an unknown result. Backup/restore must preserve the complete SQLite database including receipts.

get.description:
进程内指标，Prometheus 0.0.4 exposition。默认无需鉴权（与 `/health` 类似，便于 scrape）。`[http] metrics_public = false` 或 `JIACLAW_METRICS_REQUIRE_AUTH=1` 时与 `/api/*` 相同鉴权。不计入 HTTP 限流。

系列：`jiaclaw_http_requests_total{path,method,status}`（path 为路由族：api_chat / hooks_telegram / hooks_slack / hooks_discord / hooks_inbound / health / metrics / other）、`jiaclaw_sessions_active`、`jiaclaw_tool_calls_total{tool,result}`、`jiaclaw_build_info{version}`。

post.description: 默认同步 JSON。当请求头 `Accept: text/event-stream` 或 body `stream: true`（二者其一即可）时返回 Server-Sent Events。鉴权失败仍为 JSON 401。当前 token 事件为整轮完成后的分块推送；Brokerrouter 真流式后续。

get.description: 从权威 Memory/SQLite 存储返回有界摘要页，仅含 id 与 message_count。默认/最多 50 条，按 ID UTF-8 字节升序；has_more 为 true 时必须用 next_cursor 查询后续页。游标为末条 ID 的小写十六进制 UTF-8，after 为排他位置，不是快照。不会读取 Rust 消息正文或刷新任何 last_accessed；启用 TTL 时仍清理过期会话。网关驱动的 job: 结果在分页前排除。旧客户端必须处理新增分页字段，不能将第一页当全部。

400.description: 未知/重复参数、非规范数字、无效游标或超长查询

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: 上一页的 next_cursor；必须解码为 UTF-8。

get.description: 返回内存中该会话的消息列表。不存在或已过期返回 404。落盘开启时也以内存 store 为准。

get.description: 只读导出内存中该会话的消息。默认每行一条消息 JSON（`application/x-ndjson`），字段沿用现有 `ChatMessage`（`role`/`content`）。不触发摘要压缩、不改写 store、不刷新 last_accessed。不存在或已过期返回 404（`session_not_found`，与 GET session 一致）。`?format=json` 返回与 GET `/api/sessions/{id}` 相同的 `{id, messages}` 整包。

post.summary: 飞书企业自建应用文本回调
post.description: Self-built China Feishu app, one tenant per installation. Ordinary schema 2.0 events require SHA256(timestamp + nonce + Encrypt Key + original body), timestamp ±5 minutes, matching app_id/tenant_key/token and explicit sender/chat/tools policy. Optional AES-256-CBC encrypted envelope. URL verification requires the verification token (inside decrypted payload if encrypted), and may omit signature headers. Deduplication uses message.message_id, not header.event_id. Raw body <=128 KiB, decrypted body <=64 KiB, text <=32 KiB. Group replies use the om_ root message ID. See docs/feishu.md.

get.description: Verify query signature, timestamp and encrypted receiving CorpID, then return the exact decrypted echostr. Platform verification requires a response within 1 second; no model or outbound message is invoked. Query values are URL-decoded once. See docs/wecom.md.

post.summary: 企业微信自建应用加密文本回调
post.description: China WeCom self-built enterprise app; private member text only. Requires configured callback Token, 43-character EncodingAESKey and CorpID:AgentID installation. Validate query signature and ±5-minute timestamp before AES-256-CBC decryption (key-prefix IV, 32-byte PKCS#7 padding); validate encrypted ToUserName, AgentID and receiving CorpID suffix independently of outer fields. MsgId is the deduplication identity. Sender and destination use lowercase member UserID; no threads, group bots or smart-bot protocol. Raw XML <=128 KiB, decrypted XML <=64 KiB, text <=32 KiB; DTD and entity expansion forbidden. Authenticated accepted text is persisted before empty ACK; execution and replies run asynchronously. See docs/wecom.md.

post.summary: 钉钉企业机器人 HTTP 消息回调
post.description: Internal enterprise app robot HTTP mode, private member text only. Bind configured robotCode:corpId plus separate Client ID; verify unique timestamp/sign headers and ±1-hour millisecond timestamp. HMAC-SHA256 covers timestamp + newline + Client Secret, NOT the body: trusted HTTPS termination and confidential headers are required. Require matching robotCode, chatbotCorpId and senderCorpId for supported private text; senderStaffId retains case and is the destination. msgId is a bounded opaque dedup key. Ignore sessionWebhook entirely. Persist authorized text before empty 200 ACK; model and fixed OpenAPI sends run asynchronously. Body <=min(http.max_body_bytes,128 KiB), text <=32 KiB, JSON depth <=64. No vendor callback deadline or retry guarantee is asserted. See docs/dingtalk.md.

put.description: Strict Bearer/body/admission policy is shared with JSON PUT. Fresh202 is SSE admitted/model_started/preview/model_completed/tool_completed/done; done contains only an actually committed terminal receipt, which can require review. Missing/truncated done and error require GET of the original ID. Duplicates200 and all errors are JSON, without subscription, replay, automatic retry or Last-Event-ID. Body drop/backpressure cancels future dispatch but submitted models retain original settlement ownership. One 5s frame deadline, 8x4KiB transport queue, native8-event queue, preview2MiB/round and8MiB/turn, wire12MiB; no upstream/Web/tenant/proxy certification.

bearerAuth.description: API token。未配置 token 时不需要。

apiToken.name: X-Api-Token
apiToken.description: Bearer 的替代头。未配置 token 时不需要。

webhookSecret.name: X-Webhook-Secret
webhookSecret.description: Webhook 密钥。未配置 secret 时不需要。

telegramSecret.name: X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token
telegramSecret.description: Telegram Bot API secret token。未配置 `JIACLAW_TELEGRAM_SECRET` / `[http].telegram_secret` 时不需要。

slackSignature.name: X-Slack-Signature
slackSignature.description: Slack Events API v0 HMAC-SHA256 签名（`v0=<hex>`）。未配置 `JIACLAW_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET` / `[http].slack_signing_secret` 时不需要。

slackTimestamp.name: X-Slack-Request-Timestamp
slackTimestamp.description: Slack 请求 Unix 时间戳（秒）。与签名一起校验，时间窗 ±5 分钟。未配置 signing secret 时不需要。

discordSignature.name: X-Signature-Ed25519
discordSignature.description: Discord Interactions Ed25519 签名（hex）。未配置 `JIACLAW_DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY` / `[http].discord_public_key` 时不需要。

discordTimestamp.name: X-Signature-Timestamp
discordTimestamp.description: Discord 请求时间戳。与 Ed25519 签名一起校验（消息为 timestamp + raw body）。未配置公钥时不需要。

XRequestId.description: 请求追踪 ID。请求未携带时由服务端生成 UUID。

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: 仅当 `[http.cors]` 启用且请求 Origin 匹配（或显式配置 `*`）时出现。默认关闭则不发送。

RetryAfter.description: 仅 429。建议等待秒数（距下一次可请求，至少 1）。

XRateLimitLimit.description: 仅当限流启用且路径受保护时出现。进程内每分钟配额（burst）。

XRateLimitRemaining.description: 仅当限流启用且路径受保护时出现。本次判定后剩余可立即通过的请求数；429 时为 0。

XRateLimitReset.description: 仅当限流启用且路径受保护时出现。Unix 纪元秒（UTC），表示剩余配额补满到 X-RateLimit-Limit 的时刻（当前窗口结束）。

Unauthorized.description: API token 缺失或不匹配

NotFound.description: 会话不存在或已过期。JSON `error` 为 `session_not_found`。

BadRequest.description: 导入体非法（坏行、非法 role/content、非 UTF-8）。JSON `error` 以 `invalid_session_import` 开头。

Conflict.description: 会话 ID 已存在且未指定 overwrite。JSON `error` 为 `session_already_exists`。

PayloadTooLarge.description: 请求体超过 `[http] max_body_bytes` / `JIACLAW_MAX_BODY_BYTES`（默认 1048576 字节 / 1MiB）。JSON `error` 为 `payload_too_large`。仍回写 `X-Request-Id`。限流启用时受保护路径也可带 `X-RateLimit-*`。`GET /health` 与 `GET /metrics` 不检查该上限。

RateLimited.description: 超过进程内全局限流（429）。JSON `error` 为 `rate_limit_exceeded`。限流启用时带 `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining`（0）/ `X-RateLimit-Reset`（Unix 纪元秒，配额补满时刻）以及 `Retry-After`（秒）。

expression.description: Five fields, DOM/DOW OR; DST gaps skipped and folds use earliest instant once.

enabled_tools.description: Explicit registered background-qualified tools; empty is rejected.

delivery.description: Exact proactive destination; separate scheduled_destinations configuration and installation tool policy required. Discord requires a configured Bot Token and discord_guild_id, and supports only normal guild text channels without threads. No credentials or endpoint overrides accepted.

ScheduledJobRun.description: Persisted execution and result. completed means the result and any outbound plan committed atomically; inspect deliveries separately for platform acceptance.

stream.description: 为 true 时返回 `text/event-stream`。也可通过请求头 `Accept: text/event-stream` 开启。未设置时保持 JSON。

ModelSelection.description: Administrator-selected logical model and limits for a trusted server task purpose. This records the requested logical model, not the gateway's physical provider or certification status. Present only when model routing is configured.

model.description: Exact logical model ID sent to Brokerrouter.

ChatSseStream.description:
Server-Sent Events。每条事件为 `event: <name>` + `data: <json>`。

- `meta`: `{ session_id, request_id }`
- `token`（或后续 `delta`）: `{ text }` assistant 文本增量。**当前为整轮 tool loop 完成后的按句/按块推送；Brokerrouter 真流式后续。**
- `tool`: `{ name, ok }` 工具摘要；失败时带 `error`
- `done`: `{ reply, status, session_id }` 最终回复后关闭流；配置模型路由时另含可选 `routing`（ModelSelection）
- `error`: `{ error }` 错误后关闭流

鉴权失败不走 SSE，仍返回 JSON 401。

reloaded.description: 本次成功载入的技能数量

DiscordInteraction.description: Signed interaction. Chat commands require data.type=1 and exactly one type=3 string option. IDs must be real snowflakes; creation time controls expiry.

type.description: 1 = PONG；4 = CHANNEL_MESSAGE_WITH_SOURCE（跳过时短暂消息）；5 = DEFERRED_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_WITH_SOURCE

installation_id.description: Feishu: app_id:tenant_key. WeCom: CorpID:positive AgentID. Other platforms: configured installation ID. DingTalk: fixed robotCode:corpId; Client ID belongs in channel policy app_id, not this field.

conversation_id.description: Exact conversation ID; WeCom requires a single lowercase member UserID (1–64 ASCII bytes; first character alphanumeric, remaining characters alphanumeric or _-.@). No broadcast, department or tag targets. DingTalk: exact case-preserved member UserID (supported ASCII alphanumeric first, then alphanumeric or _-.@, 1–64 bytes), not the callback opaque conversationId.

thread_id.description: Exact platform thread key. Feishu uses om_ root message ID, never omt_ native thread ID; null targets the chat. WeCom requires null or omission. DingTalk and scheduled Discord Bot delivery require null or omission.

interaction_id.description: Discord interaction metadata; null for scheduled Discord Bot delivery and all other platforms.

expires_ms.description: Discord interaction metadata; null for scheduled Discord Bot delivery and all other platforms.

ChannelDelivery.description: Exactly one source: event_id or job_run_id. job_id identifies the scheduled run owner. Pausing/deleting a job does not cancel its existing messages.

receipt.description: Required nonempty manual receipt evidence for delivered.

ScheduledDestination.description: Exact proactive destination; separate scheduled_destinations configuration and installation tool policy required. Discord requires a configured Bot Token and discord_guild_id, and supports only normal guild text channels without threads. No credentials or endpoint overrides accepted.

DingtalkRobotCallback.description: Known fields reject duplicates. Extra platform metadata is ignored, including temporary webhook URLs and tokens. Private text additionally requires all identity/message fields described here.
